scope: PR #1254 ui.library zh-CN: the six new ui.library.time.* keys; the other 152 keys confirmed byte-identical to the 75428c035e bytes the prior receipt c94a2f70 audited
method: Read the diff, then rendered every branch through the real t() path (scripts/library-model.test.mjs plus a scratch esbuild harness) instead of asserting against the catalogue JSON. Placeholders and the ::group-off skeleton are preserved verbatim in all six; zh-CN CLDR exposes only the `other` plural category, so an `other`-only ICU plural is the correct form. The six values match the established zh-CN house style exactly (ui.presence.just_now 刚刚, ui.hub.comments.age.* N个月前/N年前, ui.settings.integrations.integration_model.* {x, number, ::group-off}N分钟前).

findings.reason: REPRODUCED, not inferred: for an asset organized under 60s ago the new fragment composes into this unchanged template as "由librarian整理于刚刚". 刚刚 is a time ADVERB, so it cannot follow the preposition 于 (于 needs a time point, which is why 于2小时前 / 于3天前 render correctly). The fragment itself is right and is the house term used in four other namespaces, so the fix belongs to the template, not to ui.library.time.just_now.
findings.disposition: deferred — the template key is outside this PR's changed bytes and editing it would move the zh-CN target hash and require a fresh audit; a one-line follow-up (e.g. "由{by}整理：{at}") re-audited on its own is the clean path. Does NOT gate: a single MINOR with no blocker/major.
